Title: Identifying HDAC3 inhibitors
Description: Screens compounds for inhibition of histone deacetylase 3, a target implicated in cancer, chronic inflammation, neurodegeneration and diabetes but which had not previously been addressed by machine learning. Li and colleagues assembled 1,098 compounds assayed against HDAC3 from ChEMBL and compared several algorithms and descriptor sets before settling on the best-performing combination, released as HDAC3i-Finder. Actives in ChEMBL cluster around explored chemotypes, so the model is most dependable within that chemical territory.
Interpretation: Probability that a compound inhibits histone deacetylase 3.
